description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Printer_HTMLDefinition, which is responsible for rendering an HTML definition object into an HTML representation. It includes methods to render doctype, environment, content sets, and element information, focusing on generating an HTML report of the document structure and rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_HTMLDefinition
classes.description: A printer class for rendering the HTML definition as an HTML report, detailing the doctype, environment, and element information.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the full HTML output for the definition, assembling doctype, environment, content sets, and info sections.

methods.name: renderDoctype
methods.description: Creates an HTML table summarizing the doctype details.

methods.name: renderEnvironment
methods.description: Creates an HTML table detailing environment-related information and transformations.

methods.name: renderContentSets
methods.description: Creates an HTML table for content set definitions.

methods.name: renderInfo
methods.description: Creates an HTML table summarizing the allowed HTML elements, their attributes, and child elements.

methods.name: renderChildren
methods.description: Renders allowed children content for an element, including special handling for types like 'chameleon' and 'custom'.

methods.name: listifyTagLookup
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated list of tags from a lookup table, filtering out non-referenced tags.

methods.name: listifyObjectList
methods.description: Creates a list of class names for objects, used for rendering attribute transforms.

methods.name: listifyAttr
methods.description: Creates a list of attribute definitions with class info.

methods.name: heavyHeader
methods.description: Creates a header row spanning multiple columns for sections.
